Usage: zealakit preset save [options] <name>

Save a preset to /Users/huynguyen/.config/zealakit/config.json

Options:
  -t, --template <template>  Template id
  -w, --with <recipes>       Comma-separated recipe ids
  --pm <manager>             Package manager
  --install                  Install dependencies by default
  --no-install               Do not install by default
  --git                      Initialize git by default
  --no-git                   Do not initialize git by default
  -h, --help                 display help for command
